summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Bindas BNB investment features - Compound and Withdraw ROI functionality. All backend API tests (14/14) passed. All frontend UI tests passed including investment card display, Compound button, and Withdraw to Balance button.
critical_code_review_comments: Investment card styling is well-implemented with grid layout showing Package, Daily ROI, Total Earned, Pending ROI sections
Compound and Withdraw buttons are properly styled and functional
CORS error from Binance API (chart data) is expected - not affecting core functionality
seed_data_creation: Test investment test-inv-1769272580743 was used for testing compound/withdraw functionality
context_for_next_testing_agent: Investment features fully tested and working. Backend APIs /api/investments/{id}/compound and /api/investments/{id}/withdraw-roi both functional. Frontend Deposit page shows Active Investments card with grid layout displaying: Package name, Amount, Daily ROI %, Daily earning in $, Total Earned, Pending ROI, Progress bar, Days completed. Compound button adds pending ROI to investment principal. Withdraw to Balance button transfers pending ROI to user's main balance. Both buttons show success alerts and update UI correctly.
